situation: Told my manager Priya in person today that I'm leaving for a job at a fintech startup. Need to send the formal written notice email now. Been there 4 years, she promoted me twice.
reply:
Hi Priya,
Following our conversation this morning, this is my formal notice of resignation. My last day will be Friday 31 October. Thank you for the past four years, and especially for pushing me to lead the billing migration when I wasn't sure I was ready. I'll have the handover doc to you by Friday and will make sure nothing drops before I go.
Best,
Mateo
note: The written note is a record, not the conversation: date, one specific thanks, the handover.

situation: 我在一个读书会当了两年组织者，现在工作太忙想退出，想在群里说一声，下个月的活动我负责的场地已经订好了。
reply: 各位书友，想跟大家说一声：我这学期结束后就不再担任读书会的组织者了。这两年跟大家一起读书特别开心，只是最近工作实在排不开，不想因为我拖了大家的节奏。11月15号那场的场地我已经订好，会办完再交接，也很乐意帮下一任组织者熟悉流程。谢谢大家！
note: 给出明确日期，说清收尾和交接，理由一句就够，不多解释。

situation: I resigned from my marketing job, my boss Greg offered me a 15% raise to stay. I've already signed with the new company. How do I say no without him getting weird for my last 3 weeks?
reply: I appreciate that, Greg, genuinely, and it means a lot that you'd make that offer. I've made my decision and I'd like to keep it clean. What I'd like is to make these three weeks as useful as possible, so tell me what you most want nailed down in the handover and I'll start there.
note: Hold the decision, don't re-argue the reason, and turn straight to the handover.

situation: I've done the books for a family bakery on a $600/month retainer for five years. I'm starting a full-time job in January and need to end it. The owner Carla has always been lovely. I called her yesterday, now I want to put it in writing.
reply:
Hi Carla,
Thanks for taking my call yesterday. To confirm in writing: I'll be ending our bookkeeping arrangement, and December will be my last month. I'll close out the year-end accounts before I go, write up a handover for whoever takes over, and I'm happy to spend an hour with them in person. If it helps, I can recommend two bookkeepers I'd trust with Ferro's. Thank you for five really good years, and for all the Friday focaccia.
Best,
Dev
note: Ending a client relationship follows the same shape as a resignation: tell them by phone, then a written note with the date, a real handover and a specific thanks.

situation: I gave notice yesterday, last day is Friday Oct 23. My manager Dave just replied on Slack: 'Honestly didn't expect this from you, leaving right before the Q4 launch really puts us in a hole.' I've been there 3 years.
reply: I understand the timing is hard, Dave, and I'm sorry it lands right before the launch. My decision is made and my last day stays Friday 23 October. I want these weeks to be useful, so I've started a handover doc for the launch checklist and can walk Leila through the vendor contacts on Thursday. Tell me what you'd most like prioritised and I'll start there.
note: After a guilt-trip, hold the date, don't re-argue the reason, and turn the conversation into a handover question.

situation: I started at a logistics startup in June and I'm quitting after 4 months. The role turned out to be mostly sales, which isn't what I signed up for. My manager Beth has been kind and I feel terrible. Meeting her tomorrow, what do I say?
reply: Beth, I wanted to tell you in person: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my two weeks' notice today, so my last day would be Wednesday 14 October. The role has turned out to be different from what I'm looking for, and I'd rather say that early than let it drag. Before I go I'll write up the status of all 23 open accounts and hand over the Harlow onboarding properly. Thank you for all the time you've put into getting me started.
note: A short tenure needs less explanation, not more: one honest line about fit, a clear date, a concrete handover, no apology tour.

situation: 大学3年生で、駅前のカフェで2年間アルバイトをしている。就活に集中したいので11月末で辞めたい。店長の佐藤さんにはとてもお世話になった。明日のシフト後に直接話すつもりだけど、何と言えばいい？
reply: 佐藤さん、少しお時間よろしいですか。就職活動に集中するため、11月30日の勤務を最後に辞めさせていただきたいと思っています。早めにお伝えしたくて、今日お話ししました。それまでのシフトはこれまで通り入りますし、新しい方が入ったら、レジと閉店作業は私がお教えします。2年間、未経験の私に一から教えてくださって、本当にありがとうございました。
note: A part-time job gets the same shape as any resignation: in person, the date first, one reason, a concrete handover and a specific thanks.

situation: J'ai annoncé ma démission à ma manager il y a deux semaines, mon dernier jour est vendredi 9 octobre. Je veux envoyer un mot d'au revoir à toute l'équipe (une quinzaine de personnes) par mail.
reply:
Bonjour à tous,
Vendredi 9 octobre sera mon dernier jour chez Atelier Nova. Merci pour ces quatre années, et en particulier pour le lancement de l'appli l'an dernier, où j'ai appris plus qu'en dix formations. Mes dossiers sont repris par Camille, qui a tout en main. Vous pouvez me joindre sur LinkedIn ou au 06 12 34 56 78, et je serais ravie de garder le contact. À très vite, j'espère.
Sophie
note: The farewell to the team comes after the manager knows: date, one specific thanks, who has your work, and how to reach you. No reasons, no score-settling.

situation: 我大学毕业后在我爸的五金厂帮忙管账，已经三年了。我想去深圳做设计，年底离开。我爸一直希望我以后接班，我怕他觉得我不孝。打算周末吃饭时当面跟他说。
reply: 爸，想跟您认真说件事：我决定年底离开厂里，12月31日是我最后一天。我想去深圳做设计，这是我一直想试的事，趁年轻去拼一拼。这三个月我会把账目理清楚，把会计小陈带出来，工资表和供应商对账都做成模板，保证我走了厂里不乱。这三年跟着您，学得最多的是怎么跟老客户打交道，这个我会一直带着。
note: 对家人也是同一个结构：当面说，先说决定和日期，理由一句，交接具体，最后是具体的感谢；接班的事不在这次辩论。

situation: I play bass in a covers band with three friends, Sam, Ollie and Kate. We gig about once a month. Our baby is due in December and I can't keep doing weekly rehearsals. I want to leave after our Halloween gig on Oct 31 without letting them down.
reply: Guys, I'd rather tell you now than fade out: with the baby due in December I can't keep up with rehearsals, so the Halloween gig on the 31st will be my last. I'll have the new set properly learned for it, and I'm happy to sit in with whoever you try out and pass on all my charts. I've loved every minute of this band, and I'll be front row at your next gig.
note: Leaving a shared commitment with friends: a clear last date, a real handover, and warmth without over-explaining.

situation: I've been treasurer of our neighborhood association for two years, and the term runs to next June. A new job means I can't keep doing it. I want to step down at the Nov 10 meeting and tell the chair, Linda, before the rest of the board.
reply:
Hi Linda, I wanted you to hear this from me before the rest of the board: I'm going to step down as treasurer at the Tuesday Nov 10 meeting. I've started a new job with long hours and I can't give the books the attention they need, so I'd rather hand over cleanly than let things slip. Before then I'll reconcile the accounts through October and write up the bank access steps, vendor list and the insurance renewal due in January. I'm happy to spend two evenings with whoever takes over. Thank you for two good years.
Paul
note: Chair first, a fixed date, one line of reason and a handover concrete enough that nobody has to chase you.

situation: 我在一家私教工作室跟李教练练了两年，现在想换到公司楼下的健身房自己练，省时间也省钱。课包还剩3节，想上完就结束，但不知道怎么开口。
reply: 李教练，跟你说一声：剩下这三节上完，我就先不续课了。公司楼下开了健身房，我想试试自己练，时间上方便很多。这两年你帮我把深蹲从空杆练到80公斤，真的很感谢。最后三节能不能帮我排一个我自己照着练的计划？
note: 结束服务关系：一句话说决定，理由一句就够，具体地感谢，再提一个让最后几次课有用的请求。

situation: 我在一个校友创业交流群里待了两年，每天几百条消息，想退群。群主是我读研时的导师王老师，怕直接退了显得不礼貌。我已经私下跟王老师说过了。
reply: 各位，我先退出这个群啦，最近消息实在跟不上，老是错过重要的信息。谢谢王老师当初拉我进来，这两年在群里认识了不少好朋友。有事随时私信我，我都在。
note: 退群也是离开：先私下告诉最在意的人，再在群里发一句简短温和的告别，不用解释太多。

situation: I'm resigning from my sales engineer job tomorrow, last day Friday Oct 30. I'm going to a direct competitor and I'd rather not tell my manager Fiona where, at least until I've started. She will definitely ask.
reply: Fiona, I wanted to tell you directly: I've decided to leave, and I'm giving my notice today. My last day will be Friday 30 October. I'd rather keep where I'm going to myself for now; it's nothing to do with you, I just want the focus on leaving well. I've started a handover doc for my six accounts and I'd like to walk you through it this week. You taught me more about running a demo than anyone, and I'm grateful for that.
note: Declining to say where is fine: say it once, kindly, never invent a cover story, and check your contract for notice or non-compete terms before the meeting.

situation: I manage a team of five designers. I told my director yesterday that I'm leaving, last day Friday Oct 30, and we agreed I'd tell the team myself at tomorrow's standup before any wider announcement. Some of them joined because of me.
reply: Before we start, I want you to hear this from me first: I've decided to leave, and my last day is Friday 30 October. It's the right next step for me, and it has nothing to do with any of you; leading this team has been the best part of my job. Nothing changes for your projects this month, and I'll meet each of you one to one this week to plan your handover and talk about what you want next. Maria and I will share the interim plan by next Wednesday. Ask me anything today, here or privately.
note: Tell your team before the wider announcement, give them the date and what happens to them, and offer one to ones so the questions have somewhere to go.

situation: Comparto piso en Madrid con tres amigas desde hace dos años. Me voy a vivir con mi pareja, Dani, y el contrato dice que hay que avisar con un mes, así que quiero irme el 31 de octubre. Mi prima Lucía busca habitación y le encantaría quedarse con la mía.
reply: Chicas, os quería contar algo antes de que os llegue por otro lado: me voy a vivir con Dani, así que el 31 de octubre será mi último día en el piso. Os lo digo hoy para cumplir el mes de preaviso del contrato. Mi prima Lucía busca habitación y le encantaría quedarse con la mía; si os parece, la traigo a cenar esta semana para que la conozcáis, y si preferís a otra persona, os ayudo a buscarla. Han sido dos años geniales con vosotras.
note: Dejar un piso compartido: fecha clara, el preaviso que marca el contrato y ayuda real para cubrir la habitación, sin decidir por ellas.
